en: Here to challenge Burgh? I'm sorry, he isn't here. He said there might be trouble somewhere in the city, and off he went!
Huh? Burgh's gone wandering off again?
Oh! Hello, Iris. Something came up, and Burgh isn't in right now.
Hmm... But isn't Burgh always disappearing? He says he can't think of anything to paint and goes wandering out of his Gym.
Hi there! Who are you? ...You're looking for Team Plasma? But Team Plasma broke up two years ago!
Oh, never mind that! You've got a problem, so I'll help you look!
Hmm... Now where would shady people go to hide?
I've got it! I bet that's where they are!
Good grief... Burgh and Iris are as bad as each other. She ran off toward the avenue, by the look of it.
Head down to the avenue and go west past the Pokémon Center. You're sure to catch her up.
Iris ran off toward the avenue. Go west past the Pokémon Center and you're sure to catch her up.
